decisions.observation: Actual same-version gzip archive contains Tau_Paper.tex and a 40866-byte fig_1_tau_picture.png. Recovery and preview tests now compare stored bytes to this original member; missing-src is still an explicitly injected mechanism condition.

Four original figure JPEGs and all four actual extended-data table satellite pages/JPEGs captured. Provider replay checks table identity, preserved captions, bytes, one local occurrence and original ordering. Historical article HTML retains its unknown HTTP envelope.

s41467-022-32108-3 has two real expandable boxes with prose. s42003-021-02908-2 has an image-only box; source title and actual PNG survive final rendering. Local HTML fixes prevent caption formulas consuming figure identities and preserve the image-only box.

Native browser DOM has the pure bold Code availability statement within acknowledgments. Original statement, CodeOcean link, code_availability classification and exactly-once rendering pass. A later image scroll timeout does not invalidate saved DOM or prove canvas recovery.

Reinspection of the previously captured original REST response found Table III alt text with Equation. The generic formula candidate shares the exact preview URL with the IEEE table; original replay verifies priority and final single table. No new live IEEE request or access-boundary change.

decisions.target: ACS and Royal Society viewer conditions
decisions.observation: Configured native browser captured current articles and article-discovered viewers. They expose direct full images, so they do not prove a missing-direct-link recovery branch. Direct HTTP 403 records are separate. One early Royal viewer candidate used an unbound figure id and is explicitly identity_verified=false; it is not same-paper evidence.

PNAS original direct image returned HTTP200; native canvas observation returned target_image_not_loaded. Science DOM was captured but first-image scroll timed out. Neither proves challenged HTTP plus successful canvas; no failure was injected. Science attempt 2 selected visible image candidates but the article navigation returned HTTP403 with cf-mitigated=challenge before verified identity. Stopped without another same-state retry or authentication; only redacted diagnostics and the observed response hash are retained, not token-bearing challenge HTML.

Two search candidates (s41522-026-01027-2 and s40359-026-04991-8) returned original HTTP200 HTML without the early-publication notice. Stale search snippets are not DOM evidence. No PDF was acquired or converted for this gap.
New Nature/BMC HTML candidates have no direct .main-content > p in the required structure. Existing direct-child scenario stays mechanism-only.

decisions.target: arXiv generic fallback and alternate author pipelines
decisions.observation: No unmodified matching publisher template identified. Ordinary LaTeXML HTML and author-bearing pages do not prove branches activated by removed selectors/metadata. Existing controlled tests and gaps remain.
